snippet.title: Fish House Simulator is now on Steam 🥳
snippet.description:
Fish House Simulator is now on Steam! 🎣

In this co-op simulation game, you’ll build and manage your own fish restaurant, satisfy your customers, and grow your business. Play solo or team up with your friends for the full experience.

🟢 Our Steam page is now live! Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist to support us:

https:// store.steampowered.com/app/4536970/Fish_House_Simulator

Stay tuned for more updates!

#IndieDev #SteamGame #SimulatorGame #wishlist #FishHouseSimulato
